name: AUC-ROC of MaSIF descriptor-distance score
description: AUC-ROC of MaSIF descriptor-distance score on 1552 entries. Correia's own score file identifies ProtCID-derived complexes by the BARE PDB code (not ID_InterfaceID like other groups), so entry_id resolution falls back to the bare code ONLY when the gold standard has a single, unambiguous interface for that code (647 of 700 cases); the remaining 53 genuinely ambiguous cases are excluded rather than guessed. Recomputed value 0.7661 vs. published 0.75 (was 0.80 on the 947-entry population before this fallback).
